# Python Learning — Agent Instructions

## Project Goal

This workspace is for learning AI end-to-end by building a production-style
fraud detection engine (models, data pipelines, agents, ops, security).
Prefer step-by-step, phase-by-phase actionable guidance over high-level theory.

## Current Session Focus

- Learning to use an existing MCP (Model Context Protocol) server.
- Learning to build a custom MCP server from scratch.

## Conventions

- No established code style yet — propose idiomatic Python (PEP 8, type hints)
  and explain *why* when introducing a new pattern for the first time.
- Keep explanations concise; favor runnable examples over long narrative.

## Build and Test

- No project scaffolding yet. When a Python package/project is created, update
  this section with the install/run/test commands.
